name: Temper
tagline: Stress-tests proposed code fixes with attacker agents and your real tests
description: Turns accepting a patch into a contest. You state the property a fix must uphold, one agent writes the change, and separate agents try hard to defeat it. The final gate reruns your real test suite on a scratch copy with no model in the loop, and any result that flips between identical reruns counts as a failure.
author: the_Arow_H
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
